d: On November 10, El Salvador President Nayib Bukele published footage of his troops carrying out anti-gang operations in Haiti. The footage showed El Salvador's MD 500 attack helicopters loading up, taking off and carrying out a bombing raid in Croix-De-Bouquets, a suburb on the outskirts of Haiti's Capital, Port-Au-Prince. During that mission, 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters were hit by air-launched rockets and the building was blown to bits.
